title: harmony_leiden
description: Run harmony integration followed by neighbour calculations, leiden clustering and run umap on the result.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: Path to the sample. Mutually exclusive with the 'input_uri' argument.

tiledb_input_uri.description: A URI containing the TileDB-SOMA objects. Mutually exclusive with the 'input' argument.

tiledb_s3_region.description: Region where the TileDB-SOMA database is hosted.

tiledb_endpoint.description: Custom endpoint to use to connect to S3

tiledb_s3_no_sign_request.description: Do not sign S3 requests. Credentials will not be loaded if this argument is provided.

layer.description: use specified layer for expression values instead of the .X object from the modality.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['output.h5mu']`

output_tiledb.description: Output the TileDB database to the specified directory instead of adding it to the existing database.

uns_neighbors.description: In which .uns slot to store various neighbor output objects.

obsp_neighbor_distances.description: In which .obsp slot to store the distance matrix between the resulting neighbors.

obsp_neighbor_connectivities.description: In which .obsp slot to store the connectivities matrix between the resulting neighbors.

obsm_integrated.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting integrated embedding.

obs_covariates.description: The .obs field(s) that define the covariate(s) to regress out.

theta.description:
Diversity clustering penalty parameter. Can be set as a single value for all batch observations or as multiple values, one for each observation in the batches defined by --obs_covariates. theta=0 does not encourage any diversity. Larger values of theta
result in more diverse clusters."

obs_cluster.description:
Prefix for the .obs keys under which to add the cluster labels. Newly created columns in .obs will 
be created from the specified value for '--obs_cluster' suffixed with an underscore and one of the resolutions
resolutions specified in '--leiden_resolution'.

leiden_resolution.description: Control the coarseness of the clustering. Higher values lead to more clusters.

obsm_umap.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting UMAP embedding.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
